headline: Russian strike kills at least 17 in Kyiv, officials say
summary: A ballistic missile attack on the capital and its region killed 17 people; Zelensky said more interceptors could have saved lives.
script: A Russian missile strike on Kyiv has killed at least seventeen people. President Zelensky said more air defence interceptors could have saved lives. The attack came as Moscow continues its campaign against the Ukrainian capital.
imageAlt: Emergency workers at the scene of the missile strike in the Kyiv region.
imageAltTwo: A view of damage in the Kyiv area following the overnight attack.
